digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and tickets clone management
propositions: Review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS volume diverges during redeploy because the Dockerfile entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, and the ensure script does not fetch or reset divergent history.
Deploy path omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS in autodeploy.sh, preventing script changes from reaching the box automatically on future deployments.
Ensure script must convergence the clone via explicit-refspec fetch and reconverge while handling absent credentials and unreachable origin gracefully to avoid aborting already-cast votes.

Pre-epoch local clone tips must adopt pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commits only when provably safe (ancestor relationship verified, no local-only commits), refusing adoption otherwise and warning operators.
Entrypoint must invoke ensure script and convergence outside the PAT block so convergence runs even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset.
Post-vote artifact write failures must remain best-effort and never undo recorded Gerrit votes.
